"""Publish the qualified shared server imports at a closed work boundary."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-upstream-v0143-stream-recovery-20261012')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-update-stream-recovery'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('current_update_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -o BatchMode=yes')
ruby = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
for key in ('RUBYLIB', 'GEM_PATH'):
    ENV[key] = ruby['environment'][key]

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-current-update-shared-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False,
             source={'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': m.sha(Path(__file__))}, evidence={})

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,), wall=300):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=wall, cpu=wall * 6 + 60,
                             rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        paths = []
        for name in ('main-current-update-server-lints-root-v3', 'main-current-update-server-focused-root-v1',
                     'main-current-update-server-full-root-v1'):
            p = B / name / 'record.json'
            v = json.loads(p.read_text())
            assert v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active']
            paths.append(dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p)))
        r['qualification_receipts'] = paths
        full = json.loads((B / 'main-current-update-server-full-root-v1/record.json').read_text())
        assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in full['source_pins'].items())
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', '^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        controller = F / 'controllers/main-current-update-shared-publication-v1.py.json'
        assert not controller.exists()
        data = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
        controller.write_text(json.dumps(dict(original_path=str(Path(__file__)), sha256=m.sha(Path(__file__)),
                                              bytes=len(data), text=data.decode()), indent=2) + '\n')
        files = [str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        report_lint = run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        assert 'skipped (' not in report_lint
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check', 'HEAD'])
        run('stage-qualified-import', ['git', 'add', '--', 'serve/server.py', 'serve/telemetry.py',
                                      'serve/test_upstream_stream_recovery.py', str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit-qualified-import', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'feat(serve): import upstream stream recovery safely'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push-qualified-import', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'sync/upstream-v0143-stream-recovery-20261012'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'complete', 'error', 'commit')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
